title: Evaluation of a coordinate query tree
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $\alpha$ be a type, let $L$ be a list of coordinates in $[n]$, and let $s,x$ be binary assignments on $[n]$. For any function assigning a coordinate decision tree to each binary assignment, the tree that queries the coordinates in $L$ and branches on whether each queried bit is $0$ or $1$, then uses that function at the resulting assignment, evaluates at $x$ to the same value as the tree assigned to the seed updated with the values of $x$ at the coordinates in $L$, evaluated at $x$.
hypotheses_covered: Seed and input binary assignments on $[n]$
A function from binary assignments to coordinate decision trees
